title: Gate review requests
empty.title: No gate reviews waiting
empty.body: Learners' requests to look at a checkpoint decision again appear here.
card.title: Review requested for {gate}
card.ownRequest: This is your own request. Another staff member must decide it.
decision.label: Decision under review for {learner}
outcome.uphold: Uphold the decision: the learner keeps working toward the gate
outcome.exception: Grant an exception: let the learner advance past this checkpoint on this course version
outcome.exceptionRoles: Only owners, admins and instructors can grant an exception.
exception.title: An exception is not evidence
exception.body: The decision keeps its status and open criteria, and the objectives are not counted as shown. It is recorded with your name and applies only to this course and gate version.
note.label: Message to the learner
note.hint: Required: at least {min} characters. The learner reads it.
